Definition: properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering
BiblicalUsage: Kacuwy is a covering — the cloth spread over the holy things when the camp moved. The Kohathites spread a covering of badgers' skins over the ark, and another over the altar, so that the holy things travelled hidden and untouched.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the coverings teach reverence: God's holy things were not handled casually, and I should not handle holy things casually either.
